title: syntopica doctor reports FAIL for brain on macOS because bin/brain runs under system python3
notes: Found 2026-11-23 installing a fresh instance on a second macOS machine (Darwin 27.2, uv 0.11, pnpm 11) following syntopica AGENTS.md.

engine_doctor_command runs <checkout>/bin/brain doctor directly, so its shebang picks /usr/bin/python3 3.9 and crashes (TypeError on PEP 604 annotations) although 'brain doctor' via the venv passes all 7 checks. Same root cause as the brain launcher task; the hub should invoke the engine through its venv or 'uv run --project'.
done_when: syntopica doctor shows PASS brain doctor on a fresh macOS install with no python3 >= 3.12 first on PATH
